## Remarks

The function is *continuous* when it is continuous at each point.

## Definition

A function $f : \R \to \R$ is *continuous at* $a$ when for each $\varepsilon > 0$ there is a $\delta > 0$ such that $|x - a| < \delta$ gives $|f(x) - f(a)| < \varepsilon$.
